description: Get a second opinion from a different model — on a design, an approach, or a tricky snippet — or ask one when the user requests it. Sends a one-shot prompt over a direct API call and returns the raw response. The model has no file access and cannot take actions; for anything touching files use delegate. Don't use it for syntax or API details you already know: a cheap model is usually less reliable than you on those. Omit model to use the configured default.

model.description: provider/model or ollama:<name>, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, ollama:llama3. Omit to use the configured default; don't pick a premium tier

prompt.description: The full question. The model has seen none of this conversation, so include the code and context it needs

system.description: Optional system prompt, e.g. a role or an answer format

name: ask_model
